name: Stonewall — Bastion
description: Guard, Fortify and recovery build an enduring occupation. Static Redoubts trade mobility for support.

name: Stonewall — Counteroffensive
description: Survive pressure, recover wounds and move mobile support behind a controlled advance.

name: Bruiser — Shock Assault
description: Cheap mobile Rush units and fragile Command support pressure the frontier before defenders settle.

name: Bruiser — Heavy Breakthrough
description: Expensive heavies need Command and selective demolition. Failed pushes expose substantial commitment.

name: The Syndicate — Combined Arms
description: Mobile Guards, Medic recovery and Command auras support a durable formation with distinct roles.

name: The Syndicate — Precision Operations
description: Remove an important piece with mobile Precision, direct Orders and a timed Sabotage window.

name: Nightwalker — Sabotage
description: Blackout disables a visible ability for a short offensive window. Handler support converts disruption into pressure.

name: Nightwalker — Assassination
description: Precision finishers and planned extraction remove critical targets while keeping fragile commitments useful.

name: Rogue — Scavenger
description: A single surviving salvage source converts nearby casualties into options. Medic, Guard and Reclaim preserve the engine.

name: Rogue — Wildcard
description: Mobile Precision, mobile recovery and readiness Orders adapt to visible threats instead of random outcomes.
